_comment: Source of truth for this service's entire RabbitMQ topology (event-contract.md, message-bus-manifest.json draft in kart-platform/docs/services/kart-inventory-service/). Nothing here is hardcoded in C# - RabbitMqTopologyProvisioner scans this file and declares every exchange/queue/binding/DLQ/retry-tier at startup, exactly like kart-identity-service and kart-category-service. Per-event DLQ names in event-contract.md (inventory.reserved.dlq, inventory.reservation-failed.dlq, inventory.released.dlq, inventory.replenished.dlq) belong to each *consumer's* own queue topology (Order/Cart/Analytics), not to this service's - mirrors kart-category-service's identical convention for CategoryUpdated's consumers.
